entries.source: They possess the #GOLD#Orcish Fury#WHITE# which allows them to increase all their damage for a few turns.
entries.target: 他们拥有 #GOLD#兽人狂暴#WHITE#，让他们能在几回合内提高造成的全部伤害。

entries.source: Infuse the mind, sacrifice the body but the Pride remains.
entries.target: 强化心智，牺牲肉体，但部落犹存。

entries.source: Yetis are a towering mass of muscle.
entries.target: 雪人族具有强大的肉体。

entries.source: Yetis are a towering mass of muscle. While normal yetis are non-sentient beasts this kind is special.
entries.target: 雪人族具有强大的肉体。通常，他们只是无知觉的野兽，但这种有所不同。

entries.source: A few orcs of the Kruk pride have mastered techno-psionics, allowing them to literally hijack a yeti's mind and transfer their own mind inside.
entries.target: 少数克鲁克部落的兽人掌握了科技灵能，能够真正劫持一只雪人的心智，并把自己的心智转移进去。

entries.source: Doing so drains their old knowledge and they need to start afresh, gaining considerable strength in the process; for the good of the Prides.
entries.target: 这样做会耗尽他们旧有的知识，必须重新开始，但在此过程中能获得强大的力量；这一切都是为了部落的利益。

entries.source: They possess the #GOLD#Algid Rage#WHITE# talent which allows them to encase their foes in blocks of ice.
entries.target: 他们拥有 #GOLD#寒冰之怒#WHITE#技能，让他们能将敌人封在冰块中。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +5 力量，-3 敏捷，+4 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔力，+1 意志，-1 灵巧
各兽人部落已沦为废墟！

entries.source: Orcs in all Var'Eyal are in dismay, hunted by the Sunwall and their newfound allies from the west.
entries.target: 瓦·埃亚尔各地的兽人们惊慌失措，被太阳堡垒和他们新结盟的西方盟友追猎。

entries.source: The Scourge from the West is back in the west, but her legacy stays strong: the orc race is once again upon the brink of destruction!
entries.target: 西方天灾回到了西方，但她的影响依旧深远：整个兽人种族再次濒临毁灭！

entries.source: But not all hope is lost.
On the isolated Clork Peninsula lies the fifth pride: Kruk's Pride; unseen and unharmed by the Scourge.
entries.target: 在与世隔绝的克拉克半岛上坐落着第五部落：克鲁克部落；他们未被西方天灾发现，也未遭其伤害。

entries.source: Yet not all is great there either, the Sunwall offensive has set up an outpost blocking the way to the mainland.
entries.target: 不幸的是，太阳堡垒建立了前哨站阻断了通向大陆的道路。

entries.source: But the worst threat comes from the peninsula itself, the main inhabitants are not the orcs, but the Atmos Tribe.
entries.target: 然而，最大的威胁来自半岛本身。半岛上的主要居民并非兽人，而是气之部族。

entries.source: A civilization of steam giants whose mastery of steamtech makes them incredible foes.
entries.target: 蒸汽巨人的文明掌控蒸汽科技，他们是无比强大的敌人。

entries.source: Play an orc, prove your worth! Use steamtech against the giants, reclaim the far east and free it from Sunwall scum!
entries.target: 用兽人种族进行游戏，证明你的价值！使用蒸汽科技对抗巨人，收复远东，将它从太阳堡垒的渣滓手中解放出来！

entries.source: Craft your own steamsaws, rocket boots, steam powered armours, and all kind of steamy technology!
entries.target: 制造自己的蒸汽链锯，火箭靴，蒸汽护甲，以及其他各式各样的蒸汽科技！

entries.source: This is your destiny! For Garkul's Legacy, for the Glory of the Pride!
entries.target: 这是你的天命！为了加库尔的遗产，为了部落的荣耀！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a strange triangular device, some kind of automated storage facility.*#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*你面前有一个奇怪的三角形设备，似乎是某种自动存储设施。*#WHITE#

entries.source: [reprogram it to order it to relocate to Kruk Pride]
entries.target: [改写程序，令其迁移至克鲁克部落]

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*You tinker with the store bot and manage to activate the relocation function.*#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*你操作了商店设备，执行了迁移程序。*#WHITE#

entries.source: [order it to go to Kruk Pride]

#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a strange triangular device, some kind of automated facility.*#WHITE#
It seems to be able to teach you the tinker crafting techniques, but requires input to do so (500 gold and a talent category point).
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你面前有一个奇怪的三角形设备，似乎是某种自动设施。*#WHITE#
它似乎能教授你插件制作技巧，但需要你付出一些代价（500金币和一点大系点）。

entries.source: [pay 500 gold and a talent category points]
#PURPLE#The %s teaches you: #GOLD#Steamtech/Physics#LAST#, #GOLD#Steamtech/Chemistry#LAST# and two starter crafting talents.
entries.target: #PURPLE#%s教会你：#GOLD#蒸汽科技/物理#LAST#, #GOLD#蒸汽科技/化学#LAST#和两项入门制造技能。

entries.source:
The machine gives you a small metallic box labelled as #{italic}#"Automated Portable Extractor"#{normal}#.
It seems to be used to break down metallic items into lumps of metal and infusions into herbs which are used to craft tinkers.

#{bold}#You will have to choose to use it or the Transmogrification Chest when you destroy items. You can choose the default one by using it with no items to destroy.#{normal}#
entries.target:
机械交给你一个小金属盒，上面写着 #{italic}#"便携式自动材料提取仪"#{normal}#。
它似乎能将金属物品拆解成金属块，将纹身拆解成用于制作插件的草药。

#{bold}#摧毁物品时，你必须选择使用它或转化之盒。没有可摧毁的物品时使用它，可以将其设为默认选项。#{normal}#

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Several loyal Orcs are eagerly waiting outside the palace to meet you; one steps forward, handing you a set of keys.  The word 'DESTRUCTICUS' is etched into one.*#WHITE#
Chief @playername@!  The Giants are fleeing, and we intercepted a scout carrying this!  We believe they can be used with...  well, you should see for yourself!  Please, come with us to the mountains just south of Kruk Pride!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*This sounds important.  You should probably head there right away!*#WHITE#
